decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the firm's docking and gate expertise, so the firm can read its results well and refine it with its own R&D, and its own page in both years shows sustained commitment.
Apron connectivity builds on the firm's installed apron hardware base, and its move from a mention to its own page in 2024 signals growing investment that the firm's integration know-how can support.

Revenue and billing software lies a bit further from the firm's core engineering knowledge, but its promotion to its own page in 2024 and its fit with the data-driven integration strategy favour keeping it.

Equipment monitoring draws directly on the firm's maintenance and installed equipment experience, giving it strong capacity to absorb and apply feedback, and its upgraded web presence in 2024 shows commitment.
